notes.title: Summer update now available!
notes.content:
Hello investigators. 

The Summer update for [i]Mythos: The Beginning[/i] is now live, featuring some quality of life upgrades and a couple of small balance tweaks.

This update includes the following changes:
[list][*]Optimised screen rendering code. Tearing and flickering should be less common on certain machines.
[*]Windowed mode will now automatically scale to your native desktop resolution, while maintaining aspect ratio.
[*]Added a new "Story Mode" difficulty setting due to popular demand. Stats of all enemies are reduced by 50% on this setting.
[*]Made enemies slightly weaker on all difficulty settings.[/list]

[*]Added a new "Story Mode" difficulty setting due to popular demand. Stats of all enemies are reduced by 50% on this setting.

tags.balance_change: [*]Made enemies slightly weaker on all difficulty settings.

notes.title: Mythos: Edge of Madness has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7049265/87c8aeca082144db5a1d4dbddef6134928f14d6e.png[/img]

Greetings, investigators!

We're proud to announce that the free [b]Edge of Madness[/b] DLC is now available for everybody who owns the Windows version of [i]Mythos: The Beginning[/i]. This is a huge update to the game that greatly overhauls and improves existing gameplay mechanics while also adding over 2 hours of brand new, terrifying content just in time for Halloween.

Some of the things you can expect to see in [b]Edge of Madness[/b] include:
[list][*]Completely rewritten combat system - combat is more balanced and viable to more builds, while still being fast and difficult.
[*]Overhauled character advancement - attribute boosts and talents are more valuable and meaningful, making different builds play more differently.
[*]Dozens of new skill checks and optional paths through the game - sequence break, bypass puzzles and more!
[*]Two completely new areas - a first person dungeon crawl through ancient catacombs, and a frightening visit to a previously unseen wing of Harborough Asylum.
[*]Expanded endings and more dynamic dialogue that take more of your choices throughout the game into account.[/list]

Can your character survive the [b]Edge of Madness[/b]?

Overhauled character advancement - attribute boosts and talents are more valuable and meaningful, making different builds play more differently.

Two completely new areas - a first person dungeon crawl through ancient catacombs, and a frightening visit to a previously unseen wing of Harborough Asylum.
Expanded endings and more dynamic dialogue that take more of your choices throughout the game into account.

notes.title: 1.1b Patch is now live!
notes.content:
Greetings investigators! Today a new patch for [i]Mythos: The Beginning[/i] went live, fixing a few minor (and not so minor) issues that were reported by the playerbase.

This fixes in this patch include:

- Meeting Peter in the morgue will now correctly prevent you from also meeting him in the library.
- Some text rewritten to make better use of available space.
- Some Steamworks adjustments.

notes.title: Holiday patch available!
notes.content:
Happy holidays, [i]Mythos[/i] fans!

A brand new update for [i]Mythos: The Beginning[/i] is now available, including some long-awaited performance and stability tweaks and some additional balancing based on player feedback.

This new patch includes:

[list]
[*]Various performance and stability tweaks.
[*]If you decide to leave the asylum after finding certain clues, your character will now acknowledge Blacktail's involvement.
[*]When talking to Blake Bell, there is a new dialogue option to acknowledge Blacktail's involvement if you've read the Watchman's Diary.
[*]Late game EXP costs have been increased to prevent characters from becoming too powerful.
[*]Early game monsters have been made easier to fight, while late game monsters have been made harder.
[*]You now get less EXP when selling unwanted supplies than before.
[*]Increased the yield of healing items on Casual difficulty.
[/list]

When talking to Blake Bell, there is a new dialogue option to acknowledge Blacktail's involvement if you've read the Watchman's Diary.

Early game monsters have been made easier to fight, while late game monsters have been made harder.
You now get less EXP when selling unwanted supplies than before.
Increased the yield of healing items on Casual difficulty.

notes.title: Director's Cut DLC Release
notes.content:
Hi all.

The free Director's Cut DLC for [i]Mythos: The Beginning[/i] will soon be live on Steam, adding a number of player requested features and general polishes to the game.

This huge update includes the following additions:

[list]
[*]Two new mid-game monsters, the Long Neck and the Flesh Eater.
[*]New puzzle solutions and ways to bypass obstacles.
[*]New skill checks have been added throughout the game, giving you more opportunities to use your character's Talents.
[*]EXP system has been slightly tweaked.
[*]Support for Steam Trading Cards (to be available very soon).
[/list]

This DLC will download automatically the next time you launch [i]Mythos[/i]. After the update is completed, your game should be version [i]1.0.0 DC[/i].

New skill checks have been added throughout the game, giving you more opportunities to use your character's Talents.

notes.title: Mythos version 1.5 now available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone. We've got another small patch available for Mythos: The Beginning this week that fixes a few small bugs and adds a new feature that has been often requested by our playerbase.

The list of changes in this update includes:

- Notebooks will no longer be consumed if you cancel out of the save screen.
- Increased the detection area for many objects. Interaction should generally feel a lot smoother now.
- Fixed some typos present in late game dialogue.
- Escaping from the gas trap room no longer leaves the screen with a permanent green tint.

This patch should automatically download when you launch the game in Steam, provided you have automatic updates enabled.

notes.title: Mythos 1.4 is live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone. Another patch for Mythos is now online. We didn't intend for there to be another so soon, but a critical bug was discovered in one of the game scripts and the code had to be replaced with an updated version.

The list of fixes includes:

- Fixed a bug that occurs if you defeat Blacktail without the use of Persuade.
- Fixed a crash that occurred if you clicked on something during a battle transition.

This patch should automatically download when you launch the game in Steam, provided you have automatic updates enabled.

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug that occurs if you defeat Blacktail without the use of Persuade.
- Fixed a crash that occurred if you clicked on something during a battle transition.

notes.title: Mythos 1.3 is live!
notes.content:
The first patch for Mythos: The Beginning went online today, updating the game to version 1.3 and adding some extra polish to the game.

The list of fixes includes:

- Fixed a bug that occurs if you defeat the first boss with Peter in your party.
- Reduced the Stamina of some late game enemies.
- Made it slightly more likely that Peter will leave your party before going into the portal.
- Added an extra line of text in the endings that plays if Peter left.

This patch should automatically download when you launch the game in Steam, provided you have automatic updates enabled.
